body:
Hi {{full_name}},

A few days ago I wrote to your colleague {{colleague_name}}, as we noticed {{companyName}} {{company_note}}. We do not yet have a direct partner in {{market_country}}, and we believe your company would be the right fit for us.

My earlier note is below, and our catalogue is here: {{catalogue_link_text}}

Would this week work for a short call with our Strategy Director, or would next week suit better?

Book a quick meeting with us: {{booking_link_text}}

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}
International Account Executive
Diablo Sugar Free


We found your business details in public and commercial sources. If you would rather not hear from us, reply "no thanks" and we will not contact you again.
